Scriptc links its prebuilt runtime into standalone WASI Wasm; runtime-pack production excluded.", "cache": "Fresh per-process work/source/application cache/tmp/Zig-local directories; Scriptc SCRIPTC_NO_CACHE=1. OS page caches and existing Zig global toolchain cache retained, never flushed. This is cold application/compiler-process startup, not a cold machine/toolchain installation.", "compiler_identity": "Scriptw source_commit is the embedded base Git revision; source_fingerprint and executable SHA identify the measured working-tree compiler. The performance evidence separately binds its source patch and publication.", "memory": "GNU time compiler-child lifetime high-water RSS, including accounted descendants; not simultaneous aggregate process-tree RSS, runtime RSS or live heap.", "resources": "Sequential children, one inherited CPU of a managed cloud machine, its inherited finite memory cap (recorded); no kernel-enforced 4GiB budget or grouped-OOM record; native/module caches unused by build wasm.", "source": "Original17 exact source/expected bytes retained; Scriptc alone receives the canonical print-to-console.log adapter.", "statistics": "Two blocks, ABBA per case with alternating first actor; second block reverses cases and actors. Four fresh builds per compiler/case; pooled and both block medians. Descriptive observations, no significance/conformance claim.", "timing": "Parent wall around GNU-time-supervised fresh compiler process; includes startup, source read, parse/lower/codegen/link and Wasm output I/O.
